_help: Project configuration. Option lists must match the Notion property options exactly. ai.pinned_model: set an exact model name (e.g. the version shown in data/ai_log.jsonl) to freeze the AI for a study; leave null to use the fallback list. research_question_descriptions: full wording of each research question, used by the semantic model. semantic: local embedding model settings (no AI quota). geography: levels for geographic filtering, from broadest to narrowest (country_code = ISO 2 letters; state = province or state name in English). synthesis: settings of the Synthesis matrix (draft findings, tiers).
research_questions: RQ4 Soil vs water C sources

research_question_descriptions.RQ1 Source/sink controls: What controls whether a forested swamp is a net source or sink of greenhouse gases (CO2, CH4, N2O), including temperature, water table and soil conditions?
research_question_descriptions.RQ2 Disturbed vs intact: How do greenhouse gas fluxes and carbon dynamics differ between disturbed and intact forested wetlands?
research_question_descriptions.RQ3 Anthropogenic impact: How do human activities such as drainage, land use, agriculture and pollution affect greenhouse gas fluxes in forested wetlands?
research_question_descriptions.RQ4 Soil vs water C sources: How is carbon distributed between soil and water in wetlands, and what are the sources of dissolved carbon and greenhouse gases?
research_question_descriptions.RQ5 Microbial taxonomy & function: What is the role of taxonomic and functional microbial diversity, such as methanogens, methanotrophs and denitrifiers, in greenhouse gas production in wetland soils and water?

synthesis._help: AI-drafted findings for papers you mark Read. max_papers_per_run keeps the free AI quota for triage; max_chars caps how much full text is sent (about 15 000 tokens). suggest_tiers fills an empty Tier, never overwrites.
